title: Service Advisor
description:
Service Advisor

Cheltenham £28,000 Basic Salary £33,000 OTE

Good Service Advisors make a busy workshop feel effortless.

We're looking for an experienced Service Advisor to join an established automotive dealership in Cheltenham.

You'll be at the centre of the customer journey, working closely with the workshop to keep vehicles moving, customers informed and expectations managed from the moment a vehicle is booked in through to collection.

If you know your way around a busy aftersales department, enjoy working with people and take pride in getting the details right, we'd like to talk.

The opportunity

This is a customer-facing role with plenty of variety. You'll be managing several vehicles and customer conversations throughout the day, balancing customer expectations with workshop capacity and making sure everyone knows what's happening.

You'll be responsible for:
- Booking vehicles into the workshop and understanding exactly what the customer needs
- Preparing accurate job cards and making sure the right information is captured from the outset
- Liaising closely with Technicians, Workshop Controllers and the wider aftersales team
- Providing clear estimates and explaining recommended work in a way customers can understand
- Keeping customers updated throughout the repair and servicing process
- Discussing additional work and obtaining customer authorisation where required
- Explaining technical information without unnecessary jargon
- Advising customers on servicing, maintenance and future requirements
- Managing queries and resolving issues calmly and professionally
- Making sure vehicles are ready for collection and the handover is smooth
- Building strong customer relationships that encourage customers to return
- Working towards customer satisfaction, departmental and commercial KPIs
- Following dealership and manufacturer processes accurately

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who understands that great Service Advising is about more than booking cars in and handing over keys.

You'll need to be confident with customers, commercially aware and organised enough to keep control when the workshop gets busy.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience as a Service Advisor within an automotive dealership
- A good understanding of workshop and aftersales operations
- Excellent communication skills, both face-to-face and over the phone
- Confidence discussing recommended and additional work with customers
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- The ability to manage competing priorities without losing sight of the customer
- A proactive approach to problem solving
- A positive, professional and team-focused attitude
- A full UK driving licence

Franchised dealership experience would be advantageous, but it isn't everything. If you have strong automotive customer service experience and the right approach, we're happy to have a conversation.

What's on offer
- £28,000 basic salary
- £33,000 OTE
- Established automotive dealership
- Supportive aftersales environment
- Training and development opportunities
- Long-term career progression
- The opportunity to build on your automotive experience within an established team

Let's talk

If you're an experienced Service Advisor in or around Cheltenham and you're open to hearing about something new, we'd like to hear from you.

You don't have to be actively looking.

If you're curious about the role, we'll give you the full picture, answer your questions honestly and let you decide whether it's right for you.

No pressure. No hard sell. Just a straightforward conversation about the opportunity and what you're looking for next.

Apply today or let us know you are interested for a confidential conversation with Pembrook Resourcing.

Please note: dealership details will be discussed confidentially with suitable candidates during the recruitment process.

title: Office Administrator
description:
Estate Agent Office Administrator - Student & Residential Lettings

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm
Pay: £12.71 - £13.00 per hour
Contract: Temporary to Permanent
Pay increase upon successful completion of the temporary-to-permanent period

Are you organised, approachable and proactive, and looking for a varied role where no two days are quite the same?

Due to an exciting increase in our property portfolio across both student accommodation and residential lettings, we are looking for an enthusiastic Office Administrator to join a busy and growing estate and lettings team.

This is much more than a traditional administration position. You'll be involved throughout the lettings journey - from advertising properties and arranging viewings to supporting new tenants with their move-in and ensuring all the necessary paperwork, council and utility arrangements are completed.

You'll communicate with a wide range of people every day, including students, private tenants, landlords, social housing contacts, local councils, contractors and utility providers, making this an interesting and people-focused role.

The Role

Working at the heart of the lettings office, you'll help ensure the property portfolio is efficiently managed and prospective and existing tenants receive a professional and friendly service.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Creating, uploading and managing property advertisements on OpenRent and other relevant platforms
- Ensuring property listings are accurate, attractive and kept up to date
- Responding to enquiries from prospective tenants and providing information about available properties
- Managing and coordinating the property viewing diary, ensuring appointments are organised efficiently for Louisa
- Booking, confirming and rearranging property viewings with prospective tenants
- Following up on enquiries and helping move prospective tenants through the lettings process
- Preparing tenancy documentation and completing the administration required when a new tenant is secured
- Coordinating tenant move-ins and ensuring all necessary documentation is completed
- Liaising with local councils regarding council tax and other tenancy-related matters
- Communicating with gas, electricity, water and other utility providers when tenants move in or out
- Engaging with students, private tenants and individuals within social housing
- Maintaining accurate tenant, landlord and property records
- Supporting tenancy renewals, move-ins and move-outs
- Liaising with landlords, contractors and tenants regarding property matters and maintenance requirements
- Helping coordinate maintenance enquiries and ensuring issues are directed to the appropriate person
- Providing ongoing administrative and customer service support to tenants throughout their tenancy
- Managing telephone calls, emails, filing, data entry and general office correspondence
- Supporting the wider team with additional duties as the property portfolio continues to expand

About You

We're looking for someone who is friendly, confident, organised and comfortable dealing with a wide variety of people.

You'll need to be able to manage several priorities at once, whether that's arranging a last-minute viewing, responding to a tenant enquiry, updating a property advert or making sure the paperwork for a new tenancy is ready.

Previous experience within administration, lettings, property, housing or customer service would be beneficial, although a positive attitude, strong communication skills and a willingness to learn are equally important.

You should be comfortable using computers and online systems, have good written and verbal communication skills and be confident speaking with tenants, landlords and external organisations.

Why Join?

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a position that combines administration, property, customer service and coordination.

With the portfolio expanding across both student and residential lettings, you'll have the opportunity to develop a broad understanding of the property and lettings sector while becoming an important part of a busy team.

Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm

£12.71 - £13.00 per hour, with an increase in pay following successful completion of the temporary-to-permanent period.

If you're organised, personable and enjoy being kept busy, this could be the perfect opportunity to develop your career within a growing property business.

Apply today to find out more.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Part Time Accounts Administrator

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
About Crowe

Crowe is a leading national firm offering audit, tax, advisory, and consulting services with global reach and local expertise. As an independent member of Crowe Global, one of the top 10 accounting networks worldwide, we have access to over 46,000 professionals across 150+ countries and more than 800 offices globally.

Our vision is to be a leader in our chosen markets, creating lasting value for our clients and our people and being a trusted partner in their success.

We are dedicated to driving client success, empowering our people, embracing sustainability, delivering technological change and acting in the public interest.

About the role

Crowe's growing Global Business Solutions department provides outsourced accounting and tax services to multinational companies. The Assistant will support more experienced members of the team in delivering timely services and solutions to clients.

Duties/Responsibilities

Preparing payments
- Predominantly assigned to the payroll teams but act as a support function for all teams.
- Raising payments in banking platform as requested by teams.
- Attention to detail required to ensure payments are raised accurately.

Collating and issuing monthly invoices on behalf of the Manager/Partner.
- Attention to detail required to ensure the correct attachments are included in the e-mails.
- Working with multiple teams in the invoicing process.

Debtor Maintenance
- Monitoring the aged debts.
- Following up with clients as required for overdue balances.
- Working with the management teams to ensure overdue balances are communicated to clients.

Accounts Payable Support
- Supporting the Global Business Solutions AP team with invoice processing.
- Communicating questions raised with local affiliates.
- Following up with management teams as needed for details on invoices received.

Required attributes
- International experience would be an advantage.
- Organised and able to deal with multiple deadlines and prioritise tasks appropriately.
- Excellent communication skills, and an ability to gain trust and develop relationships quickly.
- Able to share knowledge within the team and carry out research as needed.
- Awareness of risk, and ability to deliver high-quality documents.
- IT skills - ability to use Microsoft Excel, Word and accounting systems, such as SAGE, NetSuite etc.
- An interest in the big picture around what Global Business Solutions and the wider Firm can offer to our clients.
- Attention to detail.

Why choose Crowe?

Whatever career you choose, whether in audit, tax, marketing or HR, we can offer you a rewarding and clear career pathway, designed to help you develop your existing talents as well as discovering new ones, positioning you to make a meaningful difference to our ever-growing and varied client base.

At Crowe we foster a collaborative and inclusive culture, and we will encourage, support and guide you on an exciting professional journey of self-discovery.

We value innovation and welcome those committed to making a difference for our communities, colleagues, and clients. With access to expert knowledge, continuous learning, competitive salaries, and flexible benefits, you will have the tools to build a rewarding career.

We are committed to diversity in our teams, equal opportunity and merit-based progression. We promote a healthy working environment with an agile working approach alongside dedicated wellbeing support, helping our people to thrive both professionally and personally.

Following changes to government policy in April 2024, we only accept applications from individuals with an existing, permanent, right to live and work in the UK.

title: HR Co-Ordinator
description:
Cactus Search is delighted to be supporting a growing and high-performing organisation in the appointment of an experienced HR Co-Ordinator to join their team in Cheltenham/ Gloucester.
This is a fantastic opportunity for an HR professional who enjoys being close to the business, providing pragmatic advice to managers and employees, and getting involved across the full employee lifecycle.

You'll be joining a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where HR is genuinely valued and where you'll have the opportunity to make a visible impact.
The Role - As HR Co-Ordinator, you'll provide a broad range of HR support and advice, working closely with stakeholders across the organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing expert advice across employee relations, including performance management, disciplinaries, grievances, absence, restructures and redundancies
- Advising managers and employees on family-friendly policies, including maternity and flexible working
- Supporting effective absence management and return-to-work processes
- Conducting exit interviews and using feedback and data to identify trends and opportunities
- Supporting recruitment, interviewing and candidate assessment activity
- Developing, reviewing and implementing HR policies and procedures
- Supporting performance management and annual review processes
- Researching and introducing new HR initiatives and best practice
- Producing regular HR reports and analysing people data
- Supporting monthly payroll processes and ensuring HR data is accurate
- Providing general HR administration and day-to-day support across the employee lifecycle

You'll ideally have:
- 3+ years' practical experience in a generalist HR role
- CIPD qualification, part qualification or equivalent relevant HR experience
- Strong and current knowledge of UK employment legislation
- Experience managing a broad range of employee relations matters
- Experience developing and implementing HR policies and procedures
- Exposure to organisational change and change management
- Strong analytical skills and experience working with HR data and reporting
- Experience using HRIS and payroll systems
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- A confident, consultative approach with the ability to influence at all levels
- Strong organisation and time-management skills
- Resilience and discretion when dealing with sensitive or complex situations
- Experience supporting recruitment and talent acquisition
- An understanding of performance management and employee development

Most importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys working with people, solving problems and providing practical HR solutions, rather than simply following process.

Interested?If you're an experienced HR Generalist looking for your next opportunity in Cheltenham/ Gloucester, and you'd like to join an organisation where you can make a genuine difference, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Receptionist
description: As a GP Receptionist at Yorkleigh Surgery, which is part of the Inspire Healthcare group, you will be the first point of contact for our patients, providing a professional, friendly and efficient service both in person and over the telephone. You will play an important role in ensuring patients receive a positive experience and are directed to the most appropriate care and support. You will be responsible for managing appointment bookings, responding to patient enquiries face to face, online and by telephone, and providing appropriate information and signposting to other services where required. The role involves handling a high volume of telephone calls, welcoming and assisting patients at reception, processing requests and undertaking a wide range of administrative duties. You will be required to record information accurately on clinical systems and ensure that patient information is handled with confidentiality, professionalism and care. You will work closely with GPs, nurses, healthcare professionals and the wider practice team to support the smooth and effective day-to-day running of the practice and contribute to the delivery of high-quality patient care. This is a varied and rewarding role which requires excellent communication and organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to remain calm, courteous and professional in a busy and sometimes challenging healthcare environment. Warm, friendly and approachable, with a genuine desire to help people. A confident communicator who can build positive relationships with patients and colleagues. Organised and proactive, with the ability to manage a busy and varied workload. Calm, professional and resilient, particularly when dealing with challenging situations. A good team player who is happy to support colleagues and contribute to the wider practice. Confident using technology and willing to embrace new digital ways of working. Accurate and attentive to detail, particularly when recording information on clinical systems. Able to use initiative, think on your feet and find solutions to help patients. Committed to maintaining confidentiality and treating every patient with dignity and respect. Experience in general practice or healthcare is desirable, but attitude is just as important as experience. If you are enthusiastic, compassionate and keen to develop your career in primary care, we would love to hear from you. Greet patients warmly and assist them with the check-in process. Manage appointment scheduling and confirmations, ensuring an organised calendar for healthcare providers. Answer phone calls promptly, addressing patient inquiries and directing calls to appropriate personnel. Maintain accurate patient records and ensure confidentiality in accordance with data protection regulations. Collaborate with medical staff to ensure smooth operations within the practice. Keep the reception area tidy and organised, creating a pleasant environment for patients.
